Weakest point: selected -> cloned (cloning the gene into an expression vector).
Most of the attrition in this forecast falls at cloning the gene into an expression vector. The target's own properties are unremarkable for that step; the forecast rests on how comparable targets fared. SSGCID-BuamA.00010.i stopped at exactly this point, at selected. Treat this as a reasonable guide rather than a firm prediction. Bear in mind that 7% of this cluster's records are censored at centre closure rather than by any experimental result, so the effective evidence is thinner than the counts suggest.

Weakest point: purified -> crystallised (obtaining crystals).
The forecast puts the main risk at obtaining crystals. Nothing in the sequence features points to that step in particular, so the forecast is carried by the archive's record for comparable targets. CSGID-IDP01074 got past this point and reached deposited, so it is not a hard wall for this family. With so little precedent, do not lean on this heavily. Bear in mind that 25% of this cluster's records are censored at centre closure rather than by any experimental result, so the effective evidence is thinner than the counts suggest.

Weakest point: cloned -> expressed (getting detectable expression).
The forecast puts the main risk at getting detectable expression. Nothing in the sequence features points to that step in particular, so the forecast is carried by the archive's record for comparable targets. No relative within 30% identity is in the archive, which leaves the target's own features to carry the forecast. The evidence is thin, so this is a weak prior rather than a prediction. Bear in mind that 0 uncensored precedents in the 30% cluster leaves the target's own features to carry the forecast.
